A query created with /query and saved from the sheet's query text lands in the page file as an ordinary query block without touching the other query blocks, and reopens with the same answers after a restart.

While the query editor is open its results follow the condition rows as they are edited, before anything is saved, and previewing writes nothing to the page; an unsaved Edit as text draft changes the results only after Save query text (Martin 2026-10-14).

A query's results group sibling matches under one parent breadcrumb, builder-made conditions (scheduled and deadline ranges included) read in plain words with no advanced label, Edit opens the condition rows with the query text one Edit as text action away, and the journal range condition answers journal blocks only.
A page result row's pencil opens the page's property panel; a property changed there is written to the page's file and the row's properties show the new value.
contracts.authority: Martin 2026-10-03 (GH #619 item 8); Search/List rows are title-only with properties one pencil-click away since Martin 2026-10-04 (UI-OG-QBV-QUERY-DISPLAY); the write is the existing guarded setPageProperty path

contracts.userOutcome: Renaming a page updates the real graph and keeps linked-reference behavior coherent.

A page whose title:: differs from its filename is found and renamed by its title: the file moves to the new title's name, title:: and every [[title]] reference are rewritten, and the filename is not offered as a separate page.

Renaming onto an existing page asks for confirmation; declining leaves every file byte-identical, accepting merges the source into the survivor (aliases and blocks), rewrites references, and keeps the source's exact bytes recoverable once.
contracts.authority: og rename-merge contract (batches 8/12); title-owned rename bytes equal master (og 11e)

The wording or button labels of the native merge confirmation.
